answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Because a fabricated citation fails the ferrous check immediately, the vine audit keeps the resolved set and the plume replay shows exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 173 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 173 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
